newsitem.title: USA: Attorney says Simpson responsible for murders.
newsitem.headline: Attorney says Simpson responsible for murders.

text.p: An attorney in the O.J. Simpson civil trial Tuesday exhorted jurors to find the former football star responsible for the murders of his ex-wife and her friend, accusing him of killing them in an "uncontrollable rage."

In an impassioned closing statement, Daniel Petrocelli, the lead attorney for the victims' families, said the voices of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman were "speaking to us from the grave" and pointing to Simpson as the murderer.
Petrocelli said the victims "in their last struggling moments to stay alive provided us with the key evidence necessary to identify their killer."

He said the glove and hat that the killer left at the murder scene, the fingernail marks and cuts he alleged they left on Simpson's hand and the bloody shoeprints that led away from the bodies were ample proof that "there is a killer in this courtroom."
Simpson was acquitted on Oct. 3, 1995 murders of his ex-wife and Goldman, and is now battling a wrongful-death civil lawsuit brought by the victims' families.

As the trial moved into the phase of final summations, the two sides were confronted with the same challenge: to take the pieces of the puzzle -- three months of sometimes complex testimony -- and create compelling cases for the jury.
